name: Apollo 11 CSM Columbia
description: The command module that carried astronauts Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins to the Moon and back during the historic Apollo 11 mission.

name: Voyager 1
description: The most distant human-made object ever, Voyager 1 has traveled beyond our solar system into interstellar space.

name: International Space Station
description: A modular space station in low Earth orbit, the ISS is the largest structure ever assembled in space, hosting international crews.

name: SpaceX Crew Dragon
description: A reusable spacecraft capable of carrying up to seven passengers to the ISS and other low Earth orbit destinations.
notable: First commercial crewed spacecraft to ISS

name: Hubble Space Telescope
description: Orbiting above Earth's atmosphere, Hubble has captured iconic images of the universe for over three decades.

name: Mars Curiosity Rover
description: A car-sized rover exploring Gale Crater on Mars, searching for signs of ancient habitable environments.
notable: Confirmed Mars once had conditions for life

name: James Webb Space Telescope
description: The most powerful space telescope ever built, JWST observes the universe in infrared, revealing never-before-seen detail.
notable: Deepest view of the early universe

name: Sputnik 1
description: The world's first artificial satellite, Sputnik 1 orbited Earth for three months before re-entering the atmosphere.

name: New Horizons
description: The first spacecraft to visit Pluto, New Horizons revealed a surprisingly complex and geologically active world.
notable: First spacecraft to fly by Pluto

name: Space Shuttle Discovery
description: The most traveled spacecraft in history, Discovery flew 39 missions including deploying the Hubble Space Telescope.
notable: Most flown spacecraft in history (39 missions)

name: Cassini-Huygens
description: An orbiter-lander pair that explored Saturn for 13 years. The Huygens probe landed on Saturn's moon Titan in 2005.

name: Perseverance Rover
description: NASA's most advanced Mars rover, Perseverance searches for signs of ancient microbial life and collects samples.
notable: Carried first helicopter to another planet

name: Starship
description: The world's most powerful and fully reusable rocket system, designed to carry crew and cargo to the Moon and Mars.

name: Mars Ingenuity Helicopter
description: The first powered aircraft to fly on another planet, Ingenuity made 72 flights on Mars before ending its mission.
notable: First powered flight on another planet

name: Pioneer 10
description: The first spacecraft to travel through the asteroid belt and the first to make direct observations of Jupiter.
notable: First spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt

name: Orion MPCV
description: NASA's next-generation crewed spacecraft designed for deep space exploration, built to carry astronauts to the Moon via Artemis.

name: Tiangong Space Station
description: China's independently operated modular space station in low Earth orbit, supporting Chinese taikonauts on long-duration missions.

name: Vostok 1
description: Yuri Gagarin's historic spacecraft carried the first human into space on April 12, 1961, completing one orbit of Earth.
